title: 1948 death of Cándido Reyes López, identity resolved with conflicts
repository: Departamento de Salud de Puerto Rico via Ancestry.com
citation: Humacao, 19 November 1948; age 25; father Mauricio Reyes; mother recorded as Carmen López Díaz; informant Saturnino Reyes. The certificate reports a 12 June 1923 birth, conflicting with the original 14 July 1923 birth act. Parent, sibling-informant, age, place, and census continuity support the identity despite the maternal-surname and birth-date errors.
privacy: The original certificate contains a sensitive identifier; it is preserved only in the private image archive and is not transcribed or published.

title: San José de Gurabo baptism index: Cruz Reyes, book 15, folio 18 verso
repository: Iglesia Católica San José, Gurabo, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008126783, film 1389060, item 8, baptism index images 117-118. The Reyes section contains two Cruz entries: book 13, folio 7 verso, and book 15, folio 18 verso. No Pastora Reyes entry appears in the reviewed Reyes section. The book 15 entry is a plausible 1915-child candidate but the index does not name parents or a birth date.

title: San José de Gurabo baptism register, book 15, folio 18 verso
repository: Iglesia Católica San José, Gurabo, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008126783, film 1389060, item 2, local image 13, film frame 00125. The manuscript is visibly marked 18 verso, matching the Cruz Reyes index citation. Torn, folded, taped, and overlapping sheets obscure the relevant entry; the available image and transcript do not expose a legible child, parents, birth date, or baptism date sufficient to identify Mauricio Reyes and Carmen Díaz's daughter.
